hero.title: Built for the Future of Dining in North Africa
hero.subtitle: Restora was born from a simple belief: great food deserves great technology. We are here to make that happen.

story.label: Where it all began
story.title: From Tunisia, to the World
story.p1: We started Restora because we saw a gap — incredible restaurants across North Africa had no modern tools to manage their business or reach new customers online. Owners relied on phone calls for reservations, paper menus, and spreadsheets for inventory.
story.p2: We set out to build the platform we wished existed. Starting in Tunis in 2024, we built every feature from scratch — talking directly to hundreds of restaurant owners and diners to make sure we got it exactly right. Today, Restora powers restaurants across Tunisia and is expanding across the region.

transparency.title: Radical Transparency
transparency.desc: No hidden fees, no surprise charges. We believe in honest, clear relationships with every restaurant and every diner on our platform.

quality.title: Quality Without Compromise
quality.desc: Every restaurant on Restora is KYC-verified and reviewed before going live. We curate — we do not just aggregate.

community.title: Community First
community.desc: Restora is a living ecosystem. Owners and diners grow together, powered by shared trust, genuine reviews, and real loyalty.

innovation.title: Always Innovating
innovation.desc: We ship new features every week. From AI Copilot to dynamic pricing, we never stop building the tools that help you win.

mission.label: Our Mission
mission.title: Elevating Every Dining Experience, One Restaurant at a Time
mission.body: Our mission is to make extraordinary dining experiences accessible to everyone across North Africa, while giving restaurant owners the technology they need to compete and thrive in a digital-first world. We believe food has the power to bring communities together — and Restora is the platform that makes it possible.

q1.a: Yes. Our Starter plan is completely free and includes a restaurant listing, QR digital menu, and up to 50 orders per month. Advanced features are available on our Pro plan starting at 149 TND/month.

q2.q: How long does it take to go live?
q2.a: Most restaurants complete setup and go live within 24 hours. Our onboarding team is available to guide you, and most of the setup is fully self-service.

q3.q: Can I manage multiple restaurant branches?
q3.a: Yes. Our Enterprise plan supports multi-location management with a unified dashboard, shared menu management, and cross-branch analytics.

q4.q: Is my data secure on Restora?
q4.a: Security is our top priority. We use bank-grade AES-256 encryption, httpOnly tokens, automatic account lockout, and comply with international data security standards.

q5.a: Restora fully supports Arabic (with full RTL layout), French, and English. The platform automatically adapts to your preferred language across all pages.

q6.q: Can customers order delivery through Restora?
q6.a: Yes. Restaurants on the Pro plan can enable delivery ordering and manage their own drivers or integrate with third-party delivery services.
